description: Approved follow-up steps 2-3: replace unscoped external-ID rating lookup and its obsolete tests; preserve generic bridge rating pipeline, mapper, Person identity and permission checks, source isolation, canonical UUID and shared upsert. Real integration regressions first. Separate Engine resolution and Channels normalization, no provider parsing in Engine. Reuse SourceIdentity and TranscriptHistory authorization. Extend existing rate_message operation, no new tool.

comments.text: Implemented and issue-validated, uncommitted. All Jido adapters use {:source, reference} in shared rating dispatch. Provider/connector/native room/source scope/external message ID resolve canonical target; normalized Thread/ChannelRef native coordinates fix Telegram prefix mismatch. Active rater uses existing People.match_by_channel; existing TranscriptHistory access verifies placement before message-lock serialized shared upsert. Canonical Person rating actor only. Removed get_message_by_external_id, rate_message_by_external_id and nine directly associated obsolete tests. Preserved BO UUID checks and shared mapper/ignored/removal behavior. Real bridge->Engine->DB tests cover Mattermost/Telegram/Discord/Slack, passive external and assistant targets, conflicting old rows, isolation, unknown/inaccessible actors; property covers identical IDs across two connectors/two Telegram chats. Final 635 tests + 12 properties, mix q, diff check pass; email regression suite included. No final PR acceptance or commit.

Reopened production-path defect after user live Mattermost reaction failed. Read-only DB evidence: delivered Shared assistant UUID has confirmed receipt/placement but null canonical source fields; lookup correctly cannot resolve it. Prior tests seeded canonical capture, bypassing finalization+delivery. Added regression through admission/finalization -> HistoryDelivery -> HistoryIngress -> Jido reaction -> real rating/projection, first failing with exact not_found symptom. Action reuse: extend existing TranscriptHistory.prepare_execution_response under existing locked confirmation transaction; reuse Message.canonical_changeset immutable/unique binding; no new lookup fallback/registry. Preserve UUID/trace/legacy conversation and ID-only retry owner. No historical data repair.

Production delivery binding fix implemented, uncommitted. TranscriptHistory.prepare_execution_response now binds existing response canonical source fields using Message.canonical_changeset inside HistoryIngress confirmation transaction after execution/target validation. UUID, trace and legacy conversation preserved; source collision rolls back without receipt or partial binding. Found and fixed second production seam: chat receipts omit history_source_scope, so HistoryDelivery now defaults to Outgoing.routing_context.source_scope while preserving explicit SMTP scope. New regression uses real HistoryIngress capture + admission + finalization + HistoryDelivery confirmation + Jido reaction + DB/projection (no real provider network call), covers Mattermost Direct/Shared/thread and toned +1, Telegram Direct, Discord Shared and Slack thread, repeated confirmation/association and collision rollback. Reproduced not_found before fix; reproduced missing Telegram namespace with actual chat receipt shape before fixing fallback. Final affected suite 207 tests +5 properties, 0 failures; mix q and git diff --check passed. Earlier live test row not backfilled; user should retest fresh exchange. No live-server verification claimed; broader PR A gates remain pending.
